errors.text: The proposed SPD plus 152 MPa HIP treatment does not reconstruct the essential 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour hexahedron-anvil HPHT intervention.
The stated pressure is about 40 times lower than the target pressure and is conventional HIP rather than extreme-pressure processing.
The falsification experiment compares SPD plus HIP against HIP alone, so it isolates the effect of SPD, not the effect of extreme pressure.
The proposed island-in-matrix topology differs from the target hierarchical patterned structure with coherent FCC/B2 interfaces.
Evidence from chemically and structurally unrelated refractory HEAs is extrapolated to Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni without direct support for the claimed lamellar-to-island transformation.
The composition and initial condition are mismatched: the response specifies an as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy rather than homogenized Al0.7CoCrFeNi.
